question: caveat 4 said hyperparameters were selected after observing the 217-assay results; does that selection optimism survive a nested re-selection?

nested_selection.protocol: for each of the five assay folds, pick alpha on the training assays only, then score the held-out assays with that alpha

verdict: the one knob that materially changes the score is alpha: 0.607 at 0.6, 0.617 at 0.75, 0.621 at 0.9, 0.619 at 1.0. Re-selecting it inside every fold from the training assays alone picks 0.9 in all five folds, so the nested estimate is bit-identical to the fixed one (gap 0.000). The post-hoc choice of alpha therefore contributes no optimism
still_open: width (256) and epochs (30) were never tuned at all, and the broader design space (which mechanisms to try) was explored on this panel; results do not nest over that
